name: The American University of Paris
summary: Small American-style liberal-arts university in central Paris, all in English; 25 majors, discussion-based classes and IB scholarships.

ib.text: The IB Diploma waives the English test. Automatic scholarships by final score: 32–35 €7,000 a year up to full tuition at 44–45; 30+ points earn a year of credit.

noDeadline: Applications accepted year round; late admission after 1 April

apply.via: AUP Application Portal or the Common Application

dates.label: Regular Admission round; late admission follows after 1 April

programmes.name: Fashion Studies
programmes.about: Fashion studied as a global cultural phenomenon and an industry, in Paris: key concepts, histories and current debates, with research methods and visual and material analysis, in a liberal arts setting.
programmes.ib: No IB subjects are named. Final score sets an automatic scholarship (from 32 points: €7,000 a year, up to full tuition at 44-45); 30+ points earn a year of credit.
programmes.selectionNote: Whole application read in rounds: transcripts, two recommendations, a 650-word statement and a 300-word AUP essay. SAT/ACT are optional.

flagshipSource.title: Fashion Studies major: studied in Paris, a focal point of the global fashion system; major, minor and MA track

programmes.name: International & Comparative Politics
programmes.about: How ideas and resources move across nations: international relations theory, international political economy, international law, comparative politics and political philosophy, with research methods and rigorous argument.
programmes.ib: No IB subjects are named. Final score sets an automatic scholarship (from 32 points: €7,000 a year, up to full tuition at 44-45); 30+ points earn a year of credit.
programmes.selectionNote: Whole application read in rounds: transcripts, two recommendations, a 650-word statement and a 300-word AUP essay. SAT/ACT are optional.

flagshipSource.title: International & Comparative Politics major: close ties with international institutions, UN agencies and the media

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Computational and quantitative methods applied across subjects, plus the theory behind computing and software: Java programming, discrete mathematics and data science, with work in the Technology and Cognition Lab.
programmes.ib: No IB subjects are named. Final score sets an automatic scholarship (from 32 points: €7,000 a year, up to full tuition at 44-45); 30+ points earn a year of credit.
programmes.selectionNote: Whole application read in rounds: transcripts, two recommendations, a 650-word statement and a 300-word AUP essay. SAT/ACT are optional.

flagshipSource.title: Computer Science major: Technology and Cognition Lab, industry and university ties, small classes

notes: Official IB results must reach the Admissions Office before the first day of classes.
Tuition was €38,080 for 2026–27, plus health fees and a one-time €900 campus development fee.
SAT and ACT are optional; you send two recommendations and a 650-word statement plus a 300-word AUP essay.
